GRADE 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Selected Surah at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. read the selected surahs for use in devotional activities,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Surah completely.
   C. Selected Surah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Surah.

2. About Selected Surah at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. recite the selected surah for use in ibaadah,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Surah completely.
   C. Selected Surah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Surah.

3. About Selected Surah when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the basic meaning of the selected surah to enhance positive character formation,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected Surah completely.
   C. Selected Surah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected Surah.

5. About Hadith on Purity of Actions at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. read the selected Hadith on purity of actions for moral guidance,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on Purity of Actions completely.
   C. Hadith on Purity of Actions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on Purity of Actions.

6. About Hadith on Purity of Actions at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. apply the lessons learnt from the selected Hadith in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on Purity of Actions completely.
   C. Hadith on Purity of Actions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on Purity of Actions.

7. About Hadith on Purity of Actions when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. uphold the lessons learnt from the Hadith on purity of actions for sincerity in deeds,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on Purity of Actions completely.
   C. Hadith on Purity of Actions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on Purity of Actions.

9. About Hadith on dressing at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. read the Hadith on Islamic dressing for moral uprightness,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on dressing completely.
   C. Hadith on dressing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on dressing.

10. About Hadith on dressing at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the male and female dress code as per the Sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.),
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on dressing completely.
   C. Hadith on dressing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on dressing.

11. About Hadith on dressing when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. practise Islamic manner of dressing as an act of ibadah,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on dressing completely.
   C. Hadith on dressing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on dressing.

13. About Hadith on planting at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on planting completely.
   C. Hadith on planting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on planting.

14. About Hadith on planting at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the importance of planting trees and crops as an act of ibadah,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on planting completely.
   C. Hadith on planting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on planting.

15. About Hadith on planting when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on planting completely.
   C. Hadith on planting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on planting.

17. About Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources completely.
   C. Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

18. About Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the significance of using Allah (S.W.T.)’s bounties for the benefit in this life and the Hereafter,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources completely.
   C. Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

19. About Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life,
   B. Learners should ignore Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources completely.
   C. Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

21. About Stories of Prophets: at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the stories of the selected prophets to build their faith,
   B. Learners should ignore Stories of Prophets: completely.
   C. Stories of Prophets: is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Stories of Prophets:.

22. About Stories of Prophets: at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development,
   B. Learners should ignore Stories of Prophets: completely.
   C. Stories of Prophets: is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Stories of Prophets:.

23. About Stories of Prophets: when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. emulate the character of the prophets in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Stories of Prophets: completely.
   C. Stories of Prophets: is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Stories of Prophets:.

25. About Taqwa at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the qualities of a pious person (Muttaqiin) for character building,
   B. Learners should ignore Taqwa completely.
   C. Taqwa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Taqwa.

26. About Taqwa at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the significance of taqwa in the life of a Muslim,
   B. Learners should ignore Taqwa completely.
   C. Taqwa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Taqwa.

27. About Taqwa when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate consciousness of Allah (S.W.T.) as a mark of true belief,
   B. Learners should ignore Taqwa completely.
   C. Taqwa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Taqwa.

29. About Tawakkul at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the qualities of a mutawakkil as a basis for character building,
   B. Learners should ignore Tawakkul completely.
   C. Tawakkul is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Tawakkul.

30. About Tawakkul at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the significance of tawakkul in the life of a Muslim,
   B. Learners should ignore Tawakkul completely.
   C. Tawakkul is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Tawakkul.

31. About Tawakkul when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. practise tawakkul in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Tawakkul completely.
   C. Tawakkul is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Tawakkul.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Selected Surah at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Hadith on Purity of Actions at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Hadith on dressing at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Hadith on planting at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources at home with your family.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Stories of Prophets: at home with your family.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Taqwa at home with your family.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Tawakkul at home with your family.
